headline: Don't screw this up, Marvel
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day earned $1 billion worldwide in its opening weekend, making Hollywood history. The film reinforces Sony's hold on Spider-Man film rights. Marvel Studios made a smart move collaborating on the movie's production.

headline: Now you can securely link multiple phones to one Signal account
summary: Signal now allows linking multiple phones, including Android and iPhones, to a single account. Previously, only PCs and iPads could be linked. This feature enables checking and responding to messages across all linked devices.

headline: AMD's data center business is booming while gaming takes a backseat
summary: AMD's data center revenue more than doubled year-over-year, reaching $6.7 billion, driven by AI demand. This growth significantly outpaces its gaming segment. CEO Lisa Su highlighted strong AI capacity demand in the latest earnings report.

headline: SpaceX made more revenue as an AI company than a space company
summary: SpaceX's AI revenue tripled to $2.6 billion, surpassing its space-related income. This growth is largely due to deals providing compute power to other AI firms. The AI division is a major revenue source for the company.

headline: Save $750 Off Gigabyte's Flagship AORUS Master Gaming Laptop With GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Graphics
summary: Get a massive $750 discount on Gigabyte's AORUS Master gaming laptop. This flagship model features powerful GeForce RTX 5070 Ti graphics. It's a premium offer for a high-end gaming machine.

headline: Original Grand Tour Hosts Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond, and James May Will Cameo in the New Season
summary: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond, and James May will make cameo appearances. The former Top Gear trio joins their replacements in the upcoming season. Fans can look forward to seeing the original hosts again.

headline: Joke Game Priced at 200 Dollars Rakes In $1.3 Million on Steam Before Thousands of Players Refund It
summary: A joke game titled "This Game Costs 200 Dollars" surprisingly earned $1.3 million on Steam. The teenaged developer nearly became a millionaire from the stunt. Thousands of players eventually refunded the expensive game.

headline: The Popular Budget-Friendly Flashforge Adventurer 5M 3D Printer Drops to a Mere $135 Shipped
summary: The Flashforge Adventurer 5M 3D printer is now available for just $135, including shipping. This marks potentially the lowest price seen for a solid entry-level 3D printer. It's a popular and budget-friendly option for enthusiasts.

headline: Burnham 'looking into' conducting Epstein inquiry, says victims minister
summary: Victims Minister Alex Davies-Jones discussed an Epstein inquiry with the Prime Minister. Andy Burnham is reportedly considering conducting the inquiry. This comes after Davies-Jones' re-appointment as minister.

headline: Russian ballistic missile strike on Kyiv kills at least 14, officials say
summary: A Russian ballistic missile strike on Kyiv has killed at least 14 people. Kyiv's military administration reports a massive attack on the region. Officials confirm multiple casualties from the ongoing assault.

headline: Dewormer and scabies drugs being sold as cancer treatments, BBC investigation finds
summary: A BBC investigation uncovered dewormer and scabies drugs being sold as fake cancer treatments. A terminally ill man was falsely offered these drugs to shrink tumors. This highlights dangerous misinformation targeting vulnerable patients.

headline: Temperatures to drop briefly ahead of next UK heatwave
summary: UK temperatures and humidity are expected to drop temporarily. This brief respite comes before another heatwave is forecast. The break from high heat is likely to be short-lived, according to reports.
